invariants.rationale: Index must be within list bounds for insertion; usually enforced by collection semantics.
After insertion, node's parent is set to null (or not changed from null) before adding to the rootNodes list.
The node is inserted at the given index, so after insertion rootNodes at index points to node.
After insertion, node must be present in rootNodes.
Null nodes typically would not be inserted; method likely requires non-null node and uses its fields/methods.
